U S Silica Hldgs (SLCA) Holder Wexford Capital LP Trimmed Its Stake as Stock Declined; Tctc Holdings Has Lifted Stake in Southern Co (SO)
May 20, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Tctc Holdings Llc increased its stake in Southern Co (SO) by 14.82% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tctc Holdings Llc bought 17,055 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.19% with the market. The institutional investor held 132,111 shares of the central company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.35M, up from 115,056 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tctc Holdings Llc who had been investing in Southern Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $43.23B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.67% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $42.73. About 6.70M shares traded or 19.94% up from the average. The Southern Company (NYSE:SO) has declined 11.47% since May 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.02% the S&P500.
Charles Davidson decreased its stake in U S Silica Hldgs Inc (SLCA) by 58.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wexford Capital Lp who had been investing in U S Silica Hldgs Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.60B market cap company. (NYSE:SLCA) has declined 43.79% since May 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 55.34% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in Mastec Inc (NYSE:MTZ) by 229,575 shares in the quarter, for a total of 287,988 shares, and has risen its stake in Olin Corp (NYSE:OLN).
